caption:
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).

Surah Al-Hijr (15:99). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "你应当崇拜你的主，直到那无疑的消息来临。". Used verbatim.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "그대의 주님을 경배하라 확 실한 그날이 그대에게 오리라". Spacing-only fix: '확 실한' -> '확실한'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "定めの時が訪れるまで，あなたの主に仕えなさい。"
